key_insight: HTP-Net improves dense welding-stub segmentation by preserving fine edges, global topology, and object orientation to reduce missed detections and overlapping masks.
engineering_relevance: The model enables more reliable warehouse counting and morphological inspection of welding electrodes and wire stubs in real factory settings.
method: WEP module keeps subtle boundaries through wavelet-based downsampling.
LTR-Block adds long-range context to preserve topology in slender, crowded targets.
ODI-Seg uses rotational priors to reduce NMS errors and mask overlap.
evidence_signal: On custom and public dense-slender-target datasets, HTP-Net improved mAP50 by at least 1.2% and up to 55.3%, with deployed factory recognition accuracy reaching 99% for electrodes and 94% for wire stubs.
watch_item: Performance may depend on careful deployment tuning for industrial imaging conditions, especially when target density, occlusion, or orientation varies from the training data.
paper_title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs
